findings.title: var.subnetworks accepts NAT range combinations the Cloud NAT API rejects at apply
findings.explanation: The validations covered allowed values and 'LIST_OF_SECONDARY_IP_RANGES needs secondary_ip_range_names', but not the converse rules the API enforces: secondary_ip_range_names may only be set when LIST_OF_SECONDARY_IP_RANGES is listed, ALL_IP_RANGES must be the only value, and the list must not be empty. Each of those plans cleanly and fails on the NAT create/update. Principle is a best fit: this is an apply-time correctness bug.
findings.remediation: Add validations for the converse secondary-range rule, ALL_IP_RANGES exclusivity and a non-empty source_ip_ranges_to_nat.
